assertion.statement: For the actual maximal-stack D210 point y, the canonical Kodaira-Spencer image and specified metrics give h_(omega squared)(y)=2h_F(A_y)+2log(pi)+log210 in the original stable Faltings convention.
assertion.objects: The same Hodge determinant line, dualizing square, canonical injection with image210 omega squared and actual fiber A_y.
assertion.hypotheses: The maximal-stack model, integral injection and Yuan isometry are supplied with their specified norms.
assertion.quantifiers: At every complex embedding of the same arithmetic point y.
assertion.parameter_range: D210 maximal stack, including the bad-prime integral image; original stable Faltings metric.
assertion.uniformity: The same equality is compatible with normalized arithmetic degree and temporary base extension for height evaluation.
assertion.constants: Petersson norm ||d tau||=2 Im(tau); Hodge squared norm factor(2pi)^−2; shifts2logpi and log210.
assertion.normalizations: The sublattice210 omega squared has height h_(omega squared)−log210. Distinguish norm from squared norm.
assertion.exceptional_cases: No coarse intersection theorem or asserted smooth fine model at bad primes. This equality alone does not prove vertical section regularity or the final128 bound.
assertion.limit_order: Apply the integral image and metric isometry to the same line and point; convert to original stable Faltings normalization before the section inequality.
